thread:
Sam K.: FYI—retail gateway just returned a PO rejection for acme-retail-hw. Portal says ledger SKU mismatch. @Lina R. can you pull contract mapping?
Lina R.: on it. which PO id?
Sam K.: PO 452-99-ACME. Error in portal:
```ValidationError: SKU_ALIAS_MISMATCH\nexpected: HW-ACME-12345\nreceived: ACME-HW-12345-v2``` 
AJ (Deal Desk): Ugh, that looks like the vendor alias we patched last month. Was the mapping rolled to prod?
Lina R.: checked — mapping existed in staging only. I thought ops had promoted the alias. @Beth S. did we skip that step?
Beth S.: We didn't because legal asked for a signer confirm for that vendor. I have the email thread, trying to close it now. :grimacing:
Sam K.: Customer is waiting on provisioning, they're pushing finance. Can we hotfix the portal to accept both aliases as a fallback?
marketplace-bot: Deploy pipeline status: canary-rollback-disabled, queued hotfix job #778. ETA ~ 90m.
AJ (Deal Desk): If hotfix is >2h we should accept a manual PO override. I can get procurement to accept but need a written note saying portal accepted manual override.
Lina R.: Agree. I'm going to add an interim rule in integration: allow alias regex `ACME.*12345` for 24h. Will ping infra for a config change.
Beth S.: Legal will sign the confirmation email today, heads-up to @AJ (Deal Desk) for the manual override doc once legal confirms.
Sam K.: Thanks. Can we track this as an escalation? I'll add the PO + customer contact in case it re-surfaces.
AJ (Deal Desk): Adding to escalation tracker now — PO 452-99-ACME, issue: SKU alias not promoted, mitigation: temporary alias fallback + manual PO override, owner: Lina R., legal contact: Beth S.
Lina R.: Done. I'll follow up when infra confirms config push. :thumbsup:
Beth S.: Legal replied — signer cleared. moving to finalize. :tada:
Sam K.: Great. Once alias fallback is live, confirm here and I'll tell customer provisioning can proceed.
marketplace-bot: Hotfix job #778 started. Logs: `patch alias-rule regex ACME.*12345 --env prod`.
Lina R.: Hotfix applied to prod, tested with PO 452-99-ACME — accepted. Closing loop.
Sam K.: Awesome, thanks everyone. Closing escalation. :raised_hands:
